items.title: Love, proposals and weddings
items.text: Ask a friend out, go on dates, propose with a ring at Burj Al Arab, and plan a wedding with a guest list, bridesmaids and a best man. Guests send gifts and you both say "I do" live.
items.how: Phone → Hayati. Share your wedding invitation link so friends can RSVP.

items.title: Doctors, police and courts
items.text: Get ill and see a doctor, get arrested over a suspicious transfer and hire a lawyer, or become the doctor, officer or lawyer yourself. Every job now starts with an interview.
items.how: Phone → Dubai Health, Dubai Police or Jobs.

items.title: Order food, groceries and rides
items.text: Yalla Eats, Cluck Shack, Golden Bun, Daily Basket and Yalla Ride are on your phone. Food is delivered wherever you are and fills you up.
items.how: Tap the round phone button, then any of the new apps on the first row.

items.title: A new phone and a cleaner map
items.text: Your phone now opens right over the map with all your apps. Tap the arrow at the top for the time, your mood, streak, wallet and music.
items.how: Tap the round phone button at the bottom right. Tap any place on the map to read about it and see who's there before you go.

items.title: Invite friends to your home
items.text: Send a friend a link to your door from any chat. They go on your guest list and can walk straight in.
items.how: Phone → Messages → open a chat → 🏠 Invite to my home.

items.title: Duplexes, townhouses and luxury interiors
items.text: Two-storey homes with stairs you can climb, grand pianos, chandeliers, fireplaces and aquariums. Restyle floors, walls and panelling.
items.how: Open Home, then the ✨ Style tab. Tap the stairs to go up.

items.title: Metro announcements on phones
items.text: The Red Line voice now speaks on iPhone and Android, in English and Arabic.
items.how: Take the metro from any station on the map with your sound on.
